name: Mangletooth
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth faces execution in a Horde cage and bargains with those who visit him. He offers knowledge of his rivals and Agamaggan's ancient lore in return for their help.

sections.title: A Hostage in Chains
sections.body: Tauren hunters and orc sentries keep Mangletooth in a cage at Camp Taurajo. The captured Razormane quilboar awaits execution, but he still tries to sway his captors and visiting Horde adventurers. He urges them to strike at the enemies of his tribe, hoping to prove his worth or win his freedom.

sections.title: Betrayal from Within
sections.body: Mangletooth first tries to earn his clan's gratitude by directing Horde fighters against the rival Bristleback tribe. Then he learns that Razormane leaders Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane have abandoned him. Enraged, he turns against his own kin and sends adventurers to execute his former allies.

sections.title: The Power of Blood Shards
sections.body: Mangletooth knows the religious history of his people. During the ancient War of the Ancients, Agamaggan's spilled blood gave rise to the Barrens' massive thorns. Mangletooth gathers red crystalline Blood Shards from fallen Bristlebacks and channels the lingering divine power within them, granting ancient blessings to those who help him.

faq.answer: Mangletooth is a captured Razormane quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo. Facing execution, he bargains with adventurers, offering guidance and ancient blessings in return for their help.

faq.q: Why is Mangletooth in a cage?
faq.answer: Mangletooth was captured during clashes between the Horde and quilboar in the southern Barrens. Tauren and orc guards at Camp Taurajo keep him caged as they await his execution.

faq.q: Why does Mangletooth ask you to attack other Razormane quilboar?
faq.answer: Mangletooth asks you to attack other Razormane quilboar because Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane left him to die instead of trying to rescue him. Enraged, he wants travelers to execute them out of spite.
Blood Shards are crystals formed where Agamaggan's blood soaked into the earth when he fell during the War of the Ancients. Bristleback quilboar often carry them.

faq.q: What can you do with Blood Shards at Mangletooth?
faq.answer: When you bring Mangletooth Blood Shards, he channels Agamaggan's sacred power into temporary blessings. They grant greater strength, agility, resilience, spirit, or swiftness.

faq.q: Where does Mangletooth say Agamaggan died?
faq.answer: Mangletooth says Agamaggan fell in battle during the War of the Ancients. His spilled blood gave rise to the massive thorn spires, and his colossal skull lies enshrining a cavern to the south.

angles.text: At Camp Taurajo, Horde guards keep Mangletooth caged, yet the Horde uses his bitter grievances to strike at quilboar strongholds across the Barrens.
As a tauren, you know the plains' constant clashes between tauren hunters and quilboar. Mangletooth's willingness to turn on his own kind makes him a valuable, if unsettling, military asset.
